name: Gojou Asuna
source:
The spoiled daughter of a corporate executive, she grew up in a wealthy household and is extremely confident in her appearance. She is convinced that every man will bow to her.

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041023222235/http://www.bishoge.jp/scoop/products/museum/yuwaku.htm]ScooP archived page[/url]]
